title: Collective Mining Files NI 43-101 Technical Report for Maiden Mineral Resource for the Apollo Deposit
summary: Miami, Florida, October 22, 2026 – Collective Mining Ltd. (NASDAQ: CNL; TSX: CNL) (“Collective” or the “Company”) is...
body_markdown:
**Miami, Florida, October 22, 2026 – Collective Mining Ltd. (NASDAQ: CNL; TSX: CNL) (“Collective” or the “Company”)** is pleased to announce that it has filed an independent technical report in support of the maiden Mineral Resource estimate (“Mineral Resource”) for its Apollo deposit (“Apollo”) at the Guayabales Project in Caldas, Colombia.


The technical report, entitled “ **Guayabales Project – Apollo Mineral Resource, Caldas Department, Colombia** **“** , with an effective date of October 13, 2026, has been prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects (“NI 43-101”) and supports the maiden Mineral Resource estimate disclosed in the Company’s September 8, 2026 news release.


The technical report is available under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ ([www.sedarplus.ca](http://www.sedarplus.ca/) ), EDGAR ([www.sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/) ) and on the Company’s website ([www.collectivemining.com](https://collectivemining.com/) ).


**About Collective Mining Ltd.** ****


Founded by the team that developed and sold Continental Gold Inc. to Zijin Mining for approximately US$1.4 billion in enterprise value, Collective is a gold, silver, copper and tungsten exploration company with projects in Caldas, Colombia. The Company’s two projects are located directly within an established mining camp with ten fully permitted and operating mines.


The Company’s flagship project, Guayabales, is anchored by Apollo, a large-scale, bulk-tonnage and high-grade gold-silver-copper-tungsten deposit that hosts a maiden Mineral Resource of 2.58 million ounces AuEq Indicated (37.0 Mt at a grade of 2.17 g/t AuEq: 1.38 g/t Au, 24.4 g/t Ag, 0.14% Cu and 0.011% WO₃) and 2.83 million ounces AuEq Inferred (48.2 Mt at a grade of 1.83 g/t AuEq: 1.60 g/t Au, 8.39 g/t Ag, 0.03% Cu and 0.002% WO₃). The Company’s objectives at the Guayabales Project are to continue expansion and infill drilling at Apollo while advancing technical, environmental and permitting work across the project.


Management, insiders, a strategic investor and close family and friends own 45.2% of the outstanding shares of the Company and, as a result, are fully aligned with shareholders. The Company is listed on both the NASDAQ and the TSX under the trading symbol “CNL”.


**Qualified Persons (QP) and NI 43-101 Disclosure** ****


The Mineral Resource and the scientific and technical information relating to the Mineral Resource in the technical report and in this news release was prepared by Ivor W.O. Jones, FAusIMM, P.Geo. (APEGBC), an independent Qualified Person as defined by NI 43-101. Mr. Jones has verified the data underlying the Mineral Resource and has reviewed and approved the Mineral Resource information contained in this news release in the form and context in which it appears.

**Cautionary Note to United States Investors**

As a foreign private issuer eligible to file reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission pursuant to the U.S.-Canada Multijurisdictional Disclosure System, the Company is not currently required to prepare its mineral property disclosure in accordance with S-K 1300.
